name: How long does it take to install a bathroom night light?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a bathroom night light?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for installing a bathroom night light depends on the complexity of the project. A simple replacement of an existing fixture or installation of a plug-in unit might take less than an hour. However, installing a new hardwired night light that requires running new electrical lines, especially if walls need to be opened and repaired, can take several hours to a full day. We provide an estimated timeline during our initial assessment for projects in areas like San Bruno or Brisbane.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies from under an hour for simple units to several hours or a full day for new hardwired installations requiring electrical work.
